assumption: GPU-hours per run including startup and queue overhead: Non-LLM 0.15, LLM 1.0, naive 0.01. Planning figures, to be replaced by Pilot measurements.

stingy_queue_reality.consequence: jobs execute effectively serially, so wall-clock is close to the sum of per-run times plus queue wait

durable_storage_gb.note: two durable copies of fixed-step artifacts plus Qwen weight/cache and environment headroom; no holdout values stored

fairness_statement: LLM and Non-LLM runs do NOT have comparable cost and this is not claimed. Fairness rests on a preregistered protocol, identical information/budget disclosure and transparent reporting, not on equal runtime.
